title: Cron Event Envelope (v1)
description: Envelope for scheduled (cron / polling) triggers in stream-mode. The kernel synthesizes this envelope when an n8n Schedule Trigger fires.

scheduled_for.description: When the cron was scheduled to fire.

fired_at.description: When the trigger actually fired (may drift from scheduled_for under load).

schedule_expression.description: Cron expression or polling interval as declared in subscription.schedule.

previous_firing_at.description: Timestamp of the previous successful firing, used for resumable per-cron processing.

skipped_firings.description: Number of scheduled firings that were skipped due to a previous run still being in flight.

context.description: Free-form context payload that the n8n Schedule Trigger may attach.
